associations.finding: Current snapshot_for removes hidden players and units before legacy serialization;atomic route begins from this projection.
associations.remaining: Qualify every auxiliary position/history channel and native/local policy;31 fields are a census,not complete confidentiality.

associations.finding: Removing the whole hidden Champion/Unit removes their embedded buff/resource fields;separate journals are not covered by this fact.
associations.remaining: Audit each journal,score,result and optional channel for private resources/buffs and authorize each public field.

associations.finding: Attack journal combines supplied historical audience and current source visibility;targeted tests verify rejection and pending-event retirement.
associations.remaining: Qualify audiences for every other effect family and original producer policies;local journal limits are not Riot constants.

associations.finding: Ezreal R OnCast audio retires on connection/fog/death/model/authorization gaps without replay in the tested CPU path.
associations.remaining: Audit every positional sound family and actual playback;one voice fixture does not prove all sound confidentiality.

associations.finding: Minimap consumes filtered actors and its marker-removal test passes. Health bars consume filtered snapshot actors.
associations.remaining: Qualify health-bar cleanup on missing snapshot/camera/transform and all UI caches;no fresh GPU observation.

associations.finding: Minimap retires owned entities/materials when sources disappear;health update despawns absent actors after its preconditions.
associations.remaining: Qualify all public-state caches and early returns under vision/session changes;do not equate one UI cleanup with global cleanup.

associations.finding: Authenticated host projects each route through snapshot_for_atomic;decode_datagram separates local session context. Tests isolate own death recap and revoke audio between received frames.
associations.remaining: Qualify full reconnect handshake and every restored channel with stale/foreign frames;tested recap/new sender epoch is not an ordinary full reconnect match.

candidates.basis: Explicit current local OpenLeague protocol,not original LoL wire;no native inputs invented.

sources.scope: Current local protocol source census;literal field references are not automatically classified as secure. Native LoL network equivalence and all-channel confidentiality remain unqualified.

notes: Snapshot field census is literal,not a completed privacy proof.
Champion kill events include identities,assists,first_blood and killer_gold without position;their historical public-audience policy remains to qualify.

Legacy snapshot_for omits death_recap;atomic projection attaches viewer-specific recap. Current test covers authenticated routes and separately a new framed epoch,not a full physical disconnect/reconnect scenario.
health::update removes absent actors only after snapshot,camera and camera-transform availability;earlier returns are not fresh cleanup evidence.
Audio test covers Ezreal R OnCast voice retirement and no replay,not all positional sounds or physical listening.
scope.scope: Explicit local-protocol review;not native wire equivalence,all-field confidentiality or visual/audio acceptance.

tests.scope: Fresh targeted Rust tests. CPU UI/audio lifecycle fixtures and local protocol adapters;not physical audio listening,GPU pixels,ordinary full match,or historical network equivalence.
